name: delivery-video
description: Turn a feature that actually runs into a trustworthy delivery demo video: real screen recordings, edge-tts narration, word-synced subtitles and a deterministic quality gate.

interface.shortDescription: Record and gate delivery demo videos
interface.longDescription: Records real screen sessions of working software, renders narration and word-synced subtitles, and runs a deterministic quality gate before the video is delivered. No static screenshots, mocks or stale footage.
